fundamentals.name: Caterpillar Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Caterpillar Inc. provides construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines, and diesel-electric locomotives in the United States and internationally. The Construction Industries segment offers asphalt pavers, cold planers, compactors, forestry machines, material handlers, motor graders, pipelayers, road reclaimers, telehandlers, track-type tractors, and track and wheel excavators; backhoe, compact track, skid steer, track-type, and wheel loaders; and related parts and work tools. Its Resource Industries segment provides electric rope and hydraulic shovels, draglines, rotary drills, hard rock vehicles, mining trucks, wheel loaders, off-highway and articulated trucks, wide-body trucks, wheel tractor scrapers and dozers, and landfill and soil compactors; machinery components, and wear and maintenance components; and technology products and services for fleet management, equipment management analytics, autonomous machine capabilities, safety services, and mining performance solutions. The Energy & Transportation segment offers reciprocating engine powered generator sets; reciprocating engines, drivetrain, and integrated systems and solutions; centrifugal gas compressors and related services; and diesel-electric locomotive components, and other rail-related products. Its Financial Products segment provides operating and finance leases, revolving charge accounts, installment sale contracts, repair/rebuild financing, working capital loans, and wholesale financing; and insurance and risk management products and services. The All Other segment offers parts distribution; logistics and distribution services; electronics and control systems; dealer portfolio management; brand management and marketing strategy; and digital investment services. It also provides mining software solutions. The company was formerly known as Caterpillar Tractor Co. Caterpillar Inc. was incorporated in 1925 and is headquartered in Irving, Texas.

judgment.summary: Strong growth and returns are driving Caterpillar, though leverage and valuation warrant consideration.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter beat estimate by 19.3%; next earnings date is 2026-08-04.
positives: Revenue growth 22.2% YoY and earnings growth 30.2% YoY indicate robust top and bottom-line expansion.
Quarterly earnings growth of 27.3% and analyst estimates for current Q (30.3%) and FY (28.5%) suggest continued momentum.
Profit margin of 13.3% and a very high return on equity of 51.3% demonstrate strong profitability and efficiency.
Free cash flow of $3.78B TTM provides ample resources for operations and shareholder returns.
Consensus 'buy' rating from 26 analysts with a mean target of $936.99 suggests broad institutional confidence.
negatives: Trailing P/E of 45.59 and PEG ratio of 2.15 indicate a premium valuation, especially after a significant rally.
Debt/Equity ratio of 230.79 is very high, indicating substantial financial leverage.
Current ratio of 1.35 and quick ratio of 0.73 suggest some liquidity constraints, though manageable.
Dividend yield of 0.7% is low, indicating that income investors may not find the stock attractive.

news.paragraph: Caterpillar is benefiting from the data center build-out and strength in its Power & Energy division, with UBS recently lifting its price target. Despite a significant AI-fueled rally, analysts are questioning if the stock can continue its climb, though the consensus remains a buy. The company's latest earnings beat expectations, and the next earnings date is set for August 4th.
